verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ أَيُّوبُ وَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: But Job answered and said,
verses.web: Then Job answered,
verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיֹּ֗וב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

verses.ar: «لَيْتَ كَرْبِي وُزِنَ، وَمُصِيبَتِي رُفِعَتْ فِي ٱلْمَوَازِينِ جَمِيعَهَا،
verses.kjv: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!
verses.web: “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!
verses.he: ל֗וּ שָׁקֹ֣ול יִשָּׁקֵ֣ל כַּעְשִׂ֑י *וְהַיָּתִי (וְ֝הַוָּתִ֗י) בְּֽמֹאזְנַ֥יִם יִשְׂאוּ־יָֽחַד׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهَا ٱلْآنَ أَثْقَلُ مِنْ رَمْلِ ٱلْبَحْرِ. مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ لَغَا كَلَامِي.
verses.kjv: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.
verses.web: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash.
verses.he: כִּֽי־עַתָּ֗ה מֵחֹ֣ול יַמִּ֣ים יִכְבָּ֑ד עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן דְּבָרַ֥י לָֽעוּ׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ سِهَامَ ٱلْقَدِيرِ فِيَّ وَحُمَتَهَا شَارِبَةٌ رُوحِي. أَهْوَالُ ٱللهِ مُصْطَفَّةٌ ضِدِّي.
verses.kjv: For the arrows of the Almighty [are] within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.
verses.web: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in array against me.
verses.he: כִּ֤י חִצֵּ֪י שַׁדַּ֡י עִמָּדִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲ֭מָתָם שֹׁתָ֣ה רוּחִ֑י בִּעוּתֵ֖י אֱלֹ֣והַּ יַֽעַרְכֽוּנִי׃

verses.ar: هَلْ يَنْهَقُ ٱلْفَرَا عَلَى ٱلْعُشْبِ، أَوْ يَخُورُ ٱلثَّوْرُ عَلَى عَلَفِهِ؟
verses.kjv: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?
verses.web: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?
verses.he: הֲיִֽנְהַק־פֶּ֥רֶא עֲלֵי־דֶ֑שֶׁא אִ֥ם יִגְעֶה־שֹּׁ֝֗ור עַל־בְּלִילֹֽו׃

verses.ar: هَلْ يُؤْكَلُ ٱلْمَسِيخُ بِلَا مِلْحٍ، أَوْ يُوجَدُ طَعْمٌ فِي مَرَقِ ٱلْبَقْلَةِ؟
verses.kjv: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there [any] taste in the white of an egg?
verses.web: Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
verses.he: הֲיֵאָכֵ֣ל תָּ֭פֵל מִבְּלִי־מֶ֑לַח אִם־יֶשׁ־טַ֝֗עַם בְּרִ֣יר חַלָּמֽוּת׃

verses.ar: مَا عَافَتْ نَفْسِي أَنْ تَمَسَّهَا، هَذِه صَارَتْ مِثْلَ خُبْزِيَ ٱلْكَرِيهِ!
verses.kjv: The things [that] my soul refused to touch [are] as my sorrowful meat.
verses.web: My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.
verses.he: מֵאֲנָ֣ה לִנְגֹּ֣ועַ נַפְשִׁ֑י הֵ֝֗מָּה כִּדְוֵ֥י לַחְמִֽי׃

verses.ar: «يَا لَيْتَ طِلْبَتِي تَأْتِي وَيُعْطِينِيَ ٱللهُ رَجَائِي!
verses.kjv: Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant [me] the thing that I long for!
verses.web: “Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,
verses.he: מִֽי־יִ֭תֵּן תָּבֹ֣וא שֶֽׁאֱלָתִ֑י וְ֝תִקְוָתִ֗י יִתֵּ֥ן אֱלֹֽוהַּ׃

verses.ar: أَنْ يَرْضَى ٱللهُ بِأَنْ يَسْحَقَنِي، وَيُطْلِقَ يَدَهُ فَيَقْطَعَنِي.
verses.kjv: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
verses.web: even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
verses.he: וְיֹאֵ֣ל אֱ֭לֹוהַּ וִֽידַכְּאֵ֑נִי יַתֵּ֥ר יָ֝דֹ֗ו וִֽיבַצְּעֵֽנִי׃

verses.ar: فَلَا تَزَالُ تَعْزِيَتِي وَٱبْتِهَاجِي فِي عَذَابٍ، لَا يُشْفِقُ: أَنِّي لَمْ أَجْحَدْ كَلَامَ ٱلْقُدُّوسِ.
verses.kjv: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.
verses.web: Let it still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
verses.he: וּ֥תְהִי עֹ֨וד ׀ נֶ֘חָ֤מָתִ֗י וַאֲסַלְּדָ֣ה בְ֭חִילָה לֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ול כִּי־לֹ֥א כִ֝חַ֗דְתִּי אִמְרֵ֥י קָדֹֽושׁ׃

verses.ar: مَا هِيَ قُوَّتِي حَتَّى أَنْتَظِرَ؟ وَمَا هِيَ نِهَايَتِي حَتَّى أُصَبِّرَ نَفْسِي؟
verses.kjv: What [is] my strength, that I should hope? and what [is] mine end, that I should prolong my life?
verses.web: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?
verses.he: מַה־כֹּחִ֥י כִֽי־אֲיַחֵ֑ל וּמַה־קִּ֝צִּ֗י כִּֽי־אַאֲרִ֥יךְ נַפְשִֽׁי׃

verses.ar: هَلْ قُوَّتِي قُوَّةُ ٱلْحِجَارَةِ؟ هَلْ لَحْمِي نُحَاسٌ؟
verses.kjv: [Is] my strength the strength of stones? or [is] my flesh of brass?
verses.web: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?
verses.he: אִם־כֹּ֣חַ אֲבָנִ֣ים כֹּחִ֑י אִֽם־בְּשָׂרִ֥י נָחֽוּשׁ׃

verses.ar: أَلَا إِنَّهُ لَيْسَتْ فِيَّ مَعُونَتِي، وَٱلْمُسَاعَدَةُ مَطْرُودَةٌ عَنِّي!
verses.kjv: [Is] not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?
verses.web: Isn’t it that I have no help in me, that wisdom is driven away from me?
verses.he: הַאִ֬ם אֵ֣ין עֶזְרָתִ֣י בִ֑י וְ֝תֻשִׁיָּ֗ה נִדְּחָ֥ה מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

verses.ar: «حَقُّ ٱلْمَحْزُونِ مَعْرُوفٌ مِنْ صَاحِبِهِ، وَإِنْ تَرَكَ خَشْيَةَ ٱلْقَدِيرِ.
verses.kjv: To him that is afflicted pity [should be shewed] from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.
verses.web: “To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty.
verses.he: לַמָּ֣ס מֵרֵעֵ֣הוּ חָ֑סֶד וְיִרְאַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲזֹֽוב׃

verses.ar: أَمَّا إِخْوَانِي فَقَدْ غَدَرُوا مِثْلَ ٱلْغَدِيرِ. مِثْلَ سَاقِيَةِ ٱلْوُدْيَانِ يَعْبُرُونَ،
verses.kjv: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, [and] as the stream of brooks they pass away;
verses.web: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;
verses.he: אַ֭חַי בָּגְד֣וּ כְמֹו־נָ֑חַל כַּאֲפִ֖יק נְחָלִ֣ים יַעֲבֹֽרוּ׃

verses.ar: ٱلَّتِي هِيَ عَكِرَةٌ مِنَ ٱلْبَرَدِ، وَيَخْتَفِي فِيهَا ٱلْجَلِيدُ.
verses.kjv: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, [and] wherein the snow is hid:
verses.web: which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.
verses.he: הַקֹּדְרִ֥ים מִנִּי־קָ֑רַח עָ֝לֵ֗ימֹו יִתְעַלֶּם־שָֽׁלֶג׃

verses.ar: إِذَا جَرَتِ ٱنْقَطَعَتْ. إِذَا حَمِيَتْ جَفَّتْ مِنْ مَكَانِهَا.
verses.kjv: What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
verses.web: In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
verses.he: בְּ֭עֵת יְזֹרְב֣וּ נִצְמָ֑תוּ בְּ֝חֻמֹּ֗ו נִדְעֲכ֥וּ מִמְּקֹומָֽם׃

verses.ar: يُعَرِّجُ ٱلسَّفْرُ عَنْ طَرِيقِهِمْ، يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلتِّيهَ فَيَهْلِكُونَ.
verses.kjv: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.
verses.web: The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.
verses.he: יִ֭לָּ֣פְתוּ אָרְחֹ֣ות דַּרְכָּ֑ם יַעֲל֖וּ בַתֹּ֣הוּ וְיֹאבֵֽדוּ׃

verses.ar: نَظَرَتْ قَوَافِلُ تَيْمَاءَ. سَيَّارَةُ سَبَا رَجَوْهَا.
verses.kjv: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.
verses.web: The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.
verses.he: הִ֭בִּיטוּ אָרְחֹ֣ות תֵּמָ֑א הֲלִיכֹ֥ת שְׁ֝בָ֗א קִוּוּ־לָֽמֹו׃

verses.ar: خَزُوا فِي مَا كَانُوا مُطْمَئِنِّينَ. جَاءُوا إِلَيْهَا فَخَجِلُوا.
verses.kjv: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.
verses.web: They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.
verses.he: בֹּ֥שׁוּ כִּֽי־בָטָ֑ח בָּ֥אוּ עָ֝דֶ֗יהָ וַיֶּחְפָּֽרוּ׃

verses.ar: فَٱلْآنَ قَدْ صِرْتُمْ مِثْلَهَا. رَأَيْتُمْ ضَرْبَةً فَفَزِعْتُمْ.
verses.kjv: For now ye are nothing; ye see [my] casting down, and are afraid.
verses.web: For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.
verses.he: כִּֽי־עַ֭תָּה הֱיִ֣יתֶם *לֹא (לֹ֑ו) תִּֽרְא֥וּ חֲ֝תַ֗ת וַתִּירָֽאוּ׃

verses.ar: هَلْ قُلْتُ: أَعْطُونِي شَيْئًا، أَوْ مِنْ مَالِكُمُ ٱرْشُوا مِنْ أَجْلِي؟
verses.kjv: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?
verses.web: Did I ever say, ‘Give to me’? or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance’?
verses.he: הֲ‍ֽכִי־אָ֭מַרְתִּי הָ֣בוּ לִ֑י וּ֝מִכֹּחֲכֶ֗ם שִׁחֲד֥וּ בַעֲדִֽי׃

verses.ar: أَوْ نَجُّونِي مِنْ يَدِ ٱلْخَصْمِ، أَوْ مِنْ يَدِ ٱلْعُتَاةِ ٱفْدُونِي؟
verses.kjv: Or, Deliver me from the enemy’s hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?
verses.web: or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?
verses.he: וּמַלְּט֥וּנִי מִיַּד־צָ֑ר וּמִיַּ֖ד עָרִיצִ֣ים תִּפְדּֽוּנִי׃

verses.ar: عَلِّمُونِي فَأَنَا أَسْكُتُ، وَفَهِّمُونِي فِي أَيِّ شَيْءٍ ضَلَلْتُ.
verses.kjv: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.
verses.web: “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.
verses.he: הֹ֭ורוּנִי וַאֲנִ֣י אַחֲרִ֑ישׁ וּמַה־שָּׁ֝גִ֗יתִי הָבִ֥ינוּ לִֽי׃

verses.ar: مَا أَشَدَّ ٱلْكَلَامَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ، وَأَمَّا ٱلتَّوْبِيخُ مِنْكُمْ فَعَلَى مَاذَا يُبَرْهِنُ؟
verses.kjv: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?
verses.web: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?
verses.he: מַה־נִּמְרְצ֥וּ אִמְרֵי־יֹ֑שֶׁר וּמַה־יֹּוכִ֖יחַ הֹוכֵ֣חַ מִכֶּֽם׃

verses.ar: هَلْ تَحْسِبُونَ أَنْ تُوَبِّخُوا كَلِمَاتٍ، وَكَلَامُ ٱلْيَائِسِ لِلرِّيحِ؟
verses.kjv: Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, [which are] as wind?
verses.web: Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind?
verses.he: הַלְהֹוכַ֣ח מִלִּ֣ים תַּחְשֹׁ֑בוּ וּ֝לְר֗וּחַ אִמְרֵ֥י נֹאָֽשׁ׃

verses.ar: بَلْ تُلْقُونَ عَلَى ٱلْيَتِيمِ، وَتَحْفُرُونَ حُفْرَةً لِصَاحِبِكُمْ.
verses.kjv: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig [a pit] for your friend.
verses.web: Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.
verses.he: אַף־עַל־יָתֹ֥ום תַּפִּ֑ילוּ וְ֝תִכְר֗וּ עַל־רֵֽיעֲכֶֽם׃

verses.ar: وَٱلْآنَ تَفَرَّسُوا فِيَّ، فَإِنِّي عَلَى وُجُوهِكُمْ لَا أَكْذِبُ.
verses.kjv: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for [it is] evident unto you if I lie.
verses.web: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.
verses.he: וְ֭עַתָּה הֹואִ֣ילוּ פְנוּ־בִ֑י וְעַל־פְּ֝נֵיכֶ֗ם אִם־אֲכַזֵּֽב׃

verses.ar: اِرْجِعُوا. لَا يَكُونَنَّ ظُلْمٌ. اِرْجِعُوا أَيْضًا. فِيهِ حَقِّي.
verses.kjv: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness [is] in it.
verses.web: Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.
verses.he: שֻֽׁבוּ־נָ֭א אַל־תְּהִ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה *וְשֻׁבִי (וְשׁ֥וּבוּ) עֹ֝וד צִדְקִי־בָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: هَلْ فِي لِسَانِي ظُلْمٌ، أَمْ حَنَكِي لَا يُمَيِّزُ فَسَادًا؟
verses.kjv: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?
verses.web: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?
verses.he: הֲיֵשׁ־בִּלְשֹׁונִ֥י עַוְלָ֑ה אִם־חִ֝כִּ֗י לֹא־יָבִ֥ין הַוֹּֽות׃
